Each function must exist and be owned by the applying login (acl_functions_present, acl_functions_owned_by_login) and hold no EXECUTE entry other than checksops and the owner, which the file keeps, and PUBLIC, which it revokes, each granted by the owner (acl_functions_acl_replaceable). The only callers are the API Lambda (aws/functions/api/auth-financial-totp.mjs: all four; providers/production/checkalt-register.mjs: get_enrollment and mark_verified), which connects as checksops (data.mjs withIdentity, db-health.mjs EXPECTED_APPLICATION_ROLE checksops), so no caller loses access; no SQL function, view, policy or trigger calls them. No API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin. Adds no trigger.
